mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TS_LOCK ( LOCK_NAME, LOCK_OWNER, LOCK_TYPE, LOCK_DATE ) VALUES ( #{lockName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lockOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lockType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lockDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TS_LOCK WHERE LOCK_NAME = #{lockName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
DELETE FROM TS_LOCK WHERE LOCK_OWNER = #{lockOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT LOCK_NAME, LOCK_OWNER, LOCK_TYPE, LOCK_DATE FROM TS_LOCK ORDER BY LOCK_DATE
SELECT LOCK_NAME, LOCK_OWNER, LOCK_TYPE, LOCK_DATE FROM TS_LOCK WHERE LOCK_OWNER LIKE #{lockOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY LOCK_DATE
SELECT LOCK_NAME, LOCK_OWNER, LOCK_TYPE, LOCK_DATE FROM TS_LOCK WHERE LOCK_NAME LIKE #{lockName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY LOCK_DATE
